Kit summary

Hunter's SiegeBasicExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Deals 280% ATK DMG to a single enemy, with a 100% chance to inflict [Tenacity Down Ⅱ] for 2 turns.
Storm of Bolts Lv.1When Resonance Points reach the max limit, acts 1 extra turn. While Jocelyn is under [Soul Reaper] status, the DMG dealt by Hunter's Siege will be considered as Resonance DMG and the target will lose an extra 5% of Max HP (caps at 200% of Jocelyn's ATK).
Storm of Bolts Lv.3When Jocelyn casts Hunter's Siege, inflicts 1 layer of [The Hunted] on the enemy. If [The Hunted] is stacked to 3 layers, the target will take extra DMG by 20% of self Max HP (this extra DMG is considered as Resonace DMG, caps at 1000% of Jocelyn's ATK) and Jocelyn will grant all allies [SPD Up Ⅱ] for 2 turns.
Accurate ShootingActiveExclusive Lv.2
Deals 260% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 100% chance to inflict [Feebleness II] for 2 turns. Afterward, pursues and attacks the main target with Hunter's Siege once.
Storm of Bolts Lv.2Accurate Shooting: After dealing DMG, also reduces the target's Turn Meter by 20%. Lethal Repeating Crossbow · Resonance: Also grants [Resolute II] on all allies for 2 turns.
Unyielding MightPassive
Jocelyn blocks [Stun], [Freeze], and [Imprison] from heroes. When she deals Crit DMG, this DMG has an extra 70% Piercing Rate. Max Limit of Resonance Points: 10. When other allies deal Crit DMG by launching basic attacks or casting active skills, Jocelyn gains 1 Resonance Point (gains 3 Resonance Points if the target is a Boss); before Jocelyn's next turn starts, each ally can only grant Jocelyn Resonance Points 5 times in this way. When Resonance Points reach the max limit, replaces Lethal Repeating Crossbow with Lethal Repeating Crossbow · Resonance and resets its CD; meanwhile, Jocelyn cannot get Resonance Points before all of them are consumed.
Lethal Repeating CrossbowActiveExclusive Lv.2
Grants all allies [ATK Up Ⅱ] for 2 turns and deals 2 stages of 200% ATK DMG each to all enemies. When Resonance Points reach the max limit, replaces the skill with Lethal Repeating Crossbow · Resonance.
Storm of Bolts Lv.2Accurate Shooting: After dealing DMG, also reduces the target's Turn Meter by 20%. Lethal Repeating Crossbow · Resonance: Also grants [Resolute II] on all allies for 2 turns.
Lethal Repeating Crossbow · ResonanceActiveExclusive Lv.2
Grants all allies [ATK Up Ⅱ] for 2 turns and deals 2 stages of 200% ATK DMG (considered as Resonance DMG) each to all enemies. Afterward, enters [Soul Reaper] status: When other allies launch basic attacks or cast active skills on an enemy as the main target, Jocelyn consumes 1 Resonance Point to cast Hunter's Siege on the enemy 1 more time until all of her Resonance Points are consumed.
